description: Lists the remote MCP servers the official MCP Registry shows for a domain and what each endpoint answered to a handshake: initialized, auth_required or unreachable, tool count and tool-list drift. Use before connecting to an MCP server on that domain. For a go/no-go decision on connecting use preflight with action connect; to check your own release use mcp_precheck.
